title: Online dating and social-discovery services
summary: Dating apps are lawful in most countries, subject to consumer, data and online-safety laws (EU DSA, UK Online Safety Act, US state laws on dating-app safety). The list covers countries where dating apps are blocked, criminal-morality provisions make them risky for users and operators, or licensing is required. Several entries are from general knowledge and should be verified; blocks change frequently.

countries.name: Pakistan
countries.note: PTA blocked Tinder, Grindr, Tagged, Skout and SayHi in Sept 2020 for 'immoral content'; later reports of unblocking after compliance (Tinder/Grindr status uncertain); PECA 2016 applies.

countries.name: Iran
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Dating apps and unmarried mixed-gender dating services blocked/filtered; only state-approved matchmaking permitted.

countries.name: Saudi Arabia
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Unrelated men/women dating contrary to law; dating apps such as Tinder blocked or restricted; matchmaking only for marriage.

countries.name: Egypt
countries.note: Dating apps used for prosecutions under 'family values' provisions of Cybercrime Law 175/2018; Grindr blocked; unlicensed apps risk blocking.

countries.name: Turkey
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Lawful, but BTK has blocked some apps and regulators can block under Law 5651; Turkey requires local representative for foreign platforms.

countries.name: Indonesia
countries.note: Private ESO registration required (Komdigi); unregistered apps blocked; LGBT-oriented apps (Grindr, Blued) blocked; ITE Law morality provisions.

countries.name: United Arab Emirates
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Premarital relations restricted; dating app use is tolerated but some apps blocked by TDRA; Cybercrime Law morals provisions.

countries.name: Bangladesh
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. BTRC may block 'immoral' content; Grindr blocked; Digital/Cyber Security laws.

countries.name: Afghanistan
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Taliban prohibit unmarried mixed-gender relations; dating apps blocked.

countries.name: Qatar
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Dating apps blocked or restricted; extramarital relations criminal.

countries.name: Kuwait
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Some dating apps blocked by CITRA; morality provisions in law.

countries.name: Oman
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Dating apps blocked or restricted by TRA.

countries.name: Libya
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Extramarital relations criminal; dating apps filtered.

countries.name: Sudan
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Public order/morality laws; dating apps filtered.

countries.name: China
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Online dating needs ICP licence and content/real-name compliance; foreign apps not available without local licensed entity; Tinder not operating.

countries.name: India
countries.note: Lawful and widely used; no ban. IT Rules 2021 apply (grievance officer, takedown); obscenity laws (IT Act s.67, BNS) apply.

countries.name: Iraq
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Social/morality rules; Grindr and similar blocked; 'indecent content' campaigns by Ministry of Interior.

countries.name: Yemen
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Dating prohibited by morality norms/law; filtered.

countries.name: Brunei
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Sharia Penal Code criminalises khalwat (close proximity) and zina; dating apps limited.

countries.name: Malaysia
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. MCMC platform licensing for social media; Sharia offences for Muslims (khalwat); LGBT apps blocked.

countries.name: Vietnam
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Decree 147/2024 and cybersecurity rules require account authentication/local compliance; dating apps operate with obligations.

countries.name: Russia
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Foreign platforms must meet localisation and data-law requirements; LGBT-oriented apps banned (see lgbtq); mainstream dating apps largely withdrew.
